summary.name: Art Deco. This is a supplemental design reference, not a directly named style in the source collection.
summary.visualIdentity: Axial symmetry, stepped silhouettes, sunbursts, and repeated geometric ornament define the look. Forms reveal in layers and draw toward the center. Display type is precise and geometric. Highlights use controlled sweeps, not indiscriminate gold effects.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to ornament-led titles and posters, product and editorial introductions, explanatory narratives, and cinematic sequences with meaningful chapters. Period-themed openers, gala titles, and premium invitations are inferred from the suggested pairings, not explicitly stated.
summary.limitations: Omit or adapt Art Deco for topics too short to need chapter boundaries, transitions that obscure causality, or cuts that break a continuous-shot or loop requirement. Ornament must never sit behind body copy. Metallic looks are simulated and are not physically validated. The source favors 2D SVG; 3D routes are alternatives only.
summary.palette: This is an authored suggestion, used only when no task, brand, or approved palette is supplied. Background #151515 is dominant, foreground #F6EEDC carries text, and accent #B99A57 is reserved for ornament and one highlight sweep. Gradients are disabled. Visual cues also permit a coherent jewel-tone palette as an alternative. Preserve supplied exact colors. Contrast checks: foreground on background is 15.811, and background on accent is 6.802. These are two-color checks only, so verify composited frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit direction: reveal layers, draw forms toward the center, and use controlled highlight sweeps. Symmetric camera push-ins appear only in the suggested hybrid. Optional motion references motion-012 (chaptered handoff) and motion-015 (narrative steps) must be screened against the actual scene before use, and either may be omitted. Interaction behavior is unspecified; video state must derive from composition time.
summary.audio: Unspecified for this style. The source gives suggestions only and assigns no fixed genre, tempo, instrument, voice, or mandatory audio layer. Choose music, voiceover, effects, ambience, or silence based on topic and objective, honoring explicit user requirements and supplied assets. Keep speech intelligible, avoid clipping, and verify synchronization in the final video.
summary.assetRequirements: Unspecified; the source supplies no asset list. Local fonts and assets must load before rendering. Randomness must be seeded, and stateful simulations must be cached. Supplied exact colors and source artwork must be preserved unchanged. Missing assets should be reported, not invented.
summary.combinations: Art Deco alone suits ornament-led titles and posters. Hybrid style-104 adds axial camera staging and push-ins toward sunburst centers, keeping gold to ornament and one sweep; avoid pastel film grading and asymmetric handheld moves. Hybrid style-020 adds editorial copy spacing on ivory-on-black; ignore its taupe, avoid blur and sparkle, and keep ornament from competing with text.
summary.productionApproach: SVG is the style renderer for geometry, masks, and clipping. GSAP is the motion engine, using a paused, seekable timeline. Motion is optional, only after synchronization is verified. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for assembly, timing, audio sync, validation, and export. Remotion is a fallback only when a verified limitation applies, and that reason must be recorded. chroma.js is optional for color validation and contrast checks. Verify key frames and the full decoded video before delivery.
